videos.title: Senco Gold reports record festive retail sales of over ₹2,426 crore

beats.say: Senco Gold says its festive season brought in its highest-ever retail net sales value, over 2,426 crore rupees.

beats.title: The *41-day* window
beats.say: The company measured the 41-day period from 1 October to 11 November 2026.

beats.title: Company-reported *figure*
beats.say: These are the company's own numbers, reported by Business Standard. This is a news update, not advice.

scene.text: Record festive retail NSV of over ₹2,426 crore

videos.description: Senco Gold says it recorded its highest-ever retail net sales value of over ₹2,426 crore in the 41-day festive period from 1 October to 11 November 2026, as reported by Business Standard.
videos.caption: Senco Gold reports record festive retail sales of over ₹2,426 crore for 1 Oct to 11 Nov 2026 (Business Standard).

videos.title: Kaynes Technology Q2 FY27: net profit ₹39.8 crore vs ₹115.7 crore a year ago

beats.say: Kaynes Technology reported a Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit of 39.8 crore rupees, against 115.7 crore in the same quarter last year.

beats.title: Profit *versus* a year ago
beats.say: That is a clear drop from the year-ago quarter, and Business Standard reported that the stock fell over two sessions.

videos.description: Kaynes Technology reported a consolidated net profit of ₹39.8 crore for Q2 FY27, compared with ₹115.7 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, per Business Standard.
videos.caption: Kaynes Technology Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit: ₹39.8 crore vs ₹115.7 crore a year earlier (Business Standard).

videos.title: Retail credit up 18.8% to ₹185.2 trillion; EU steel duty on India

beats.say: India's retail credit grew 18.8 percent year on year to 185.2 trillion rupees in Q2 FY27, with gold and secured business loans growing strongly.

beats.title: EU steel *anti-dumping* duty
beats.say: The European Union has imposed anti-dumping duty on steel imports from India and four other countries, effective today.

scene.text: EU imposes anti-dumping duty on steel imports from India
scene.sub: Also covers Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam · effective today

beats.title: Margin funding at *₹1.53 trn*
beats.say: Business Standard also reports margin-funded stock purchases reached 1.53 trillion rupees, up 29 percent in a year.

videos.description: Retail credit rose 18.8% year on year to ₹185.2 trillion in Q2 FY27, the EU imposed anti-dumping duty on steel imports from India, and margin-funded stock purchases reached ₹1.53 trillion, per Business Standard.
videos.caption: Retail credit up 18.8% to ₹185.2 trillion in Q2 FY27; EU anti-dumping duty on Indian steel takes effect today (Business Standard).
